description: This file manages WhatsApp Web authentication state, including reading, restoring, checking existence, and logging credentials, as well as handling logout and web identity retrieval.

methods.name: resolveDefaultWebAuthDir
methods.description: Returns the default directory path for WhatsApp Web authentication data.

methods.name: readCredsJsonRaw
methods.description: Reads raw credentials JSON from a specified file, returns null if not valid or not found.

methods.name: maybeRestoreCredsFromBackup
methods.description: Restores credentials from backup if the main creds file is invalid or missing.

methods.name: webAuthExists
methods.description: Checks if WhatsApp Web authentication credentials exist and are valid.

methods.name: clearLegacyBaileysAuthState
methods.description: Removes legacy Baileys authentication files from the auth directory.

methods.name: logoutWeb
methods.description: Logs out from WhatsApp Web by deleting credentials and optionally clearing legacy state.

methods.name: readWebSelfId
methods.description: Reads cached WhatsApp Web identity info from disk.

methods.name: readWebSelfIdentity
methods.description: Retrieves the current WhatsApp Web identity, with fallback options.

methods.name: getWebAuthAgeMs
methods.description: Returns age of the web auth state in milliseconds or null if missing.

methods.name: logWebSelfId
methods.description: Logs human-readable info about the current web session identity.

methods.name: pickWebChannel
methods.description: Selects a web channel, ensuring a session exists, or throws an error.
